children: FB Financial made available a September 2026 Fixed Income Investor Presentation highlighting $16.8bn assets, strong capital and 2Q26 financial metrics.
$16.8bn total assets, $12.9bn loans HFI and $14.3bn deposits as of 2Q26, underscoring balance-sheet scale.
Capital and reserves: 11.0% CET1, 12.9% total capital, 9.5% tangible common equity/tangible assets and 1.51% ACL/loans HFI.
Profitability: 1.44% ROAA, 14.6% return on average tangible common equity (adjusted) and 3.95% NIM (FTE) in 2Q26.
Liquidity: ~$1.8bn on-balance-sheet liquidity and ~2.43x coverage of uninsured/uncollateralized deposits with additional external capacity.
Mortgage segment improved to $1.6m pre-tax contribution in 2Q26 despite lower lock volumes; efficiency ratio 52.3% (52.0% adjusted).
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
